jobs.title: Implementation Specialist
jobs.description:
**Company:**


Crexendo, Inc. (NASDAQ: CXDO) is a Public Company in the cloud telecommunications industry providing both telecommunications services to businesses and software solutions to telecommunication resellers. We’re an award\-winning premier provider of Unified Communications as a Service (UCaaS), Call Center as a Service (CCaaS), communication platform software solutions, and collaboration services designed to provide enterprise\-class cloud communication solutions to any size business through our business partners, agents, and direct channels, and we have an immediate openings for (2\) Implementation Specialist roles.

 **Position Overview**


The Implementation Specialist is responsible for leading and executing customer onboarding and system implementations for Crexendo’s cloud telecom solutions.This is a highly visible, customer\-facing role that blends project management, technical configuration, and client consulting.You will serve as the primary point of contact during implementation — ensuring projects are delivered on time, configured correctly, and positioned for long\-term customer success.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead end\-to\-end onboarding for new customers implementing their Crexendo system
* Develop and manage individualized project plans for each client.
* Coordinate cross\-functionally with Sales, Porting, and Support teams.
* Provide consultative guidance on system configuration and best practices.
* Deliver customer with baseline training to ensure successful adoption.
* Troubleshoot mid\-level telecommunications and configuration issues.
* Escalate complex technical issues appropriately.
* Maintain current knowledge of product features, updates, and enhancements.

**Qualifications**

* 3–5 years of experience in telecommunications, VoIP, UCaaS, CCaaS, or network technology.
* Previous project management or client onboarding experience preferred.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to manage multiple concurrent projects.
* Working knowledge of Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook).
* High School diploma required; Associate’s or Bachelor’s degree preferred.
* Technical certifications are a plus.

 **Employer Offered Benefits:**


Crexendo offers a comprehensive benefits package including; medical, vision, dental, holiday pay, paid time off (PTO), paid sick time (PST), and up to 3\.5% 401K match.

jobs.title: Implementation Specialist
jobs.description:
#### **About Melita**



For more than 30 years, Melita Group has helped small and mid\-sized employers solve the complexity of HR, Employee Benefits, and Payroll. We combine deep expertise with a modern technology platform to deliver outsourced services that let our clients focus on growing their businesses while we handle the operational backbone of their workforce. We are a results\-driven, high\-integrity organization that holds itself accountable to its promises, and our clients stay with us for years, often decades, because we treat their success as our own. As we scale, we are investing heavily in technology, automation, and AI to raise the bar on what an HR outsourcing partner can deliver.


#### **The Opportunity**



Every new client relationship begins with implementation, and the quality of that experience sets the trajectory for retention, expansion, and reference\-ability for years to come. The Implementation Specialist is a hands\-on role that supports bringing complex HR, benefits, and payroll clients live on our platform. You will do the configuration, data migration, and testing yourself, not just manage it from a distance.



Reporting to the Head of Implementations, you will support onboardings end to end and be the connective tissue that ensures what was sold is what gets delivered. This role is ideal for someone who has implemented outsourced Payroll and HR services at a PEO, an HRO, or an HRIS technology vendor, and who wants to do the work, contribute to the outcome, and help shape how we implement as we scale.


#### **Reporting and Scope**


* **Reports to:** Head of Implementations (Molly Taylor)
* **Department and team:** Client Success, Implementation Team
* **Location:** Remote (U.S.)
* **Key partners:** Sales, Client Success, Service Delivery, the internal Technology team, Product, and Finance, along with HRIS and benefits carrier partners

### **Core Responsibilities:**


#### **Client Implementations (hands\-on)**


* Support and help execute new client onboardings across HR administration, payroll, benefits, and leave of absence services, from kickoff to a clean handoff to the ongoing service teams.
* Contribute directly to the outcomes that matter: time to live, client satisfaction at go\-live, and a smooth transition to Service Delivery.
* Help build and maintain the implementation project plan, support progress against milestones, and help keep every workstream on schedule.

#### **Platform Configuration, Data Migration, and Integrations (hands\-on)**


* Configure the client's HRIS and complete the build yourself on platforms including ADP Workforce Now, Paylocity, and Rippling, and in our Salesforce environment.
* Run data migrations and validate the results: employee data, payroll history, benefit plans and deductions, and PTO balances.
* Stand up the data interfaces that keep everything in sync, including benefits carrier EDI feeds and GL file feeds, partnering with our internal Technology team where deeper build is required.

#### **Cross\-Functional Partnership**


* Work hand\-in\-hand with Sales, Client Success, Service Delivery, Product, and Finance to align on client expectations, scope, pricing assumptions, and post\-implementation transitions.
* Be the connective tissue that ensures what was sold is what gets delivered.

#### **AI, Automation, and Continuous Improvement**


* Identify and champion opportunities to apply AI, automation, and modern tooling to implementation workflows. This is a priority investment area for Melita.
* Document and improve implementation workflows so each onboarding is faster and cleaner than the last.

#### **What We Are Looking For**


* Very strong, hands\-on experience supporting and implementing outsourced Payroll and HR services, ideally gained at a PEO, an HRO, or an HRIS technology vendor that installs a full HRIS together with outsourced services.
* Hands\-on HRIS implementation experience on one or more major platforms (ADP Workforce Now, Paylocity, or Rippling), including configuration and data migration.
* Hands\-on payroll processing experience, multi\-state processing, tax setup, and mid\-year conversions with YTD balancing
* A proven track record running end\-to\-end implementations and managing a project plan across multiple workstreams and deadlines.
* A natural problem\-solver who thrives on complexity and drives clarity, and a systems thinker who bridges workflows across teams.
* Excellent communication skills and a high\-integrity, client\-first approach.
### **Qualifications:**


#### **Preferred Qualifications**


* Experience implementing benefits administration and leave of absence services, not only payroll and HR.
* Familiarity with benefits carrier EDI feeds, GL file feeds, and integrations across HRIS, payroll, and benefits systems.
* Experience with Salesforce and with AI\-enabled or automation\-heavy implementation workflows.
* A project management credential (for example PMP or CAPM) is a plus but not required.
* A payroll professional credential (for example FPC or CPP) is a plus but not required.


We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

jobs.title: Training Specialist
jobs.description:
At Colibri Group, culture is at the heart of everything we do. Our values Love, Joy, Boldness, Teamwork, and Curiosity—guide how we work together, support our customers, and make a difference in the communities we serve.



Colibri Group is a leader in online professional education, serving more than one million learners each year across a family of trusted education brands. Our Customer Service teams support those learners from the front lines, helping them navigate questions, solve problems, and get the most from their experience with Colibri.


**Come Build What’s Next**



We’re looking for a Training Specialist Customer Service to help our Customer Service Representatives build the knowledge, skills, and confidence they need to deliver exceptional customer experiences across voice, chat, and email.



This is an individual contributor role responsible for new hire onboarding, continuous learning, e\-learning development, and performance enablement within a fast\-moving Customer Service environment. You’ll build and facilitate learning experiences, identify opportunities for improvement through performance and Quality Assurance insights, and help teams successfully adopt new tools, processes, and ways of working.



We’re looking for someone who can do more than simply deliver training. You should be equally comfortable building an e\-learning course from the ground up, facilitating an engaging live session, analyzing where employees need additional support, and consulting with stakeholders to recommend the right learning solution.


**What You’ll Do**


* Design, develop, and deliver scalable onboarding, e\-learning, and continuous learning programs that improve and maintain Customer Service Representative performance
* Facilitate engaging live virtual and instructor\-led training across new hire onboarding, upskilling, process changes, technical topics, and ongoing professional development
* Partner consultatively with Customer Service leaders, Quality Assurance, and other stakeholders to identify performance gaps and recommend learning solutions, not simply take training requests at face value
* Use QA trends, learner feedback, KPIs, and post\-training performance data to evaluate training effectiveness and identify opportunities for targeted reinforcement or improvement
* Maintain training programs and operations, including LMS content, course materials, scheduling, completion tracking, readiness documentation, and updates required as tools, technology, products, and processes evolve

**What You’ll Bring**


* 3\+ years of experience in training, Learning \& Development, Customer Service, contact center operations, or a related environment
* Hands\-on experiencedeveloping e\-learning and training content, along with demonstrated experience facilitating live virtual and/or instructor\-led learning
* A strong understanding of adult learning principles and the ability to translate complex processes, tools, or information into clear and engaging learning experiences
* A consultative approach to stakeholder partnership, with the confidence to assess needs, ask thoughtful questions, and recommend solutions based on performance needs
* Strong communication, presentation, organization, and execution skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and adapt quickly in a collaborative, evolving environment

A bachelor’s degree in Education, Business, Organizational Development, or a related field is helpful, but equivalent professional experience is equally valued.


**Tools, Platforms, and Methodologies You May Use**



Experience with every tool or platform below is not required. We are most interested in your ability to build effective learning experiences, learn new technology quickly, and use data to continuously improve training.


* Learning Management Systems (LMS)
* E\-learning and digital content development tools
* Virtual training and collaboration platforms
* Microsoft Office and productivity tools
* Quality Assurance, performance reporting, and learner feedback data

**Why You’ll Love Working Here**


* Own meaningful training programs that directly influence how prepared and confident our Customer Service Representatives are in supporting customers
* Build both live and digital learning experiences rather than being limited to facilitating preexisting content
* Work closely with Customer Service, Quality Assurance, and cross\-functional stakeholders to solve real performance challenges
* Help shape learning programs as Colibri introduces new tools, technologies, processes, and customer service models
* Join a collaborative, supportive team where your creativity, judgment, and ideas are encouraged and your work will have a visible impact

**We Encourage You to Apply**



You may not check every preferred box, and that is okay! Strong candidates may come from contact center training, Customer Service enablement, corporate Learning \& Development, instructional design, technical training, or other high\-volume employee learning environments.



However, this role does require hands\-on experience developing training or e\-learning content and confidently facilitating live learning experiences. If your recent experience has primarily involved coordinating training or delivering materials created entirely by others, this may not provide the depth needed for this particular opportunity.



If you enjoy creating learning experiences, working closely with stakeholders, helping employees grow, and seeing a direct connection between your training and improved performance, we would love to hear from you.


**What You Can Expect From Our Hiring Process**



We want our interview process to give you a clear picture of the role, the team, and what it’s like to work at Colibri while giving us the opportunity to understand your experience, how you approach your work, and what you’re looking for next.


**We do not use AI to review applications. Your application is reviewed by a human on our Talent Acquisition team!!**



While the exact process may vary slightly by role, you can generally expect:


**1\. Recruiter Conversation**  

An introductory conversation with a member of our Talent Acquisition team to learn more about your experience, career goals, and interest in Colibri. We’ll also share more about the role, team, compensation, and what to expect throughout the process.


**2\. Hiring Manager Conversation**  

A deeper discussion with the hiring manager focused on your training and e\-learning experience, facilitation approach, stakeholder partnership, and how you approach identifying and solving performance needs.


**3\. Team and/or Cross\-Functional Interviews**  

Depending on the role, you may meet with future teammates, partners, or leaders you would work closely with. These conversations are designed to explore the experiences most relevant to the position while giving you the opportunity to learn more about how the team works together.


**4\. Final Conversation and Decision**  

For some roles, there may be a final conversation with an additional leader or stakeholder. Our Talent Acquisition team will keep you informed about next steps and timing throughout the process.



Our goal is to make the experience thoughtful, respectful, and transparent. We encourage you to ask questions throughout the process—we’re evaluating the opportunity together.


**Our Commitment to Inclusion**



Colibri Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone feels welcome, respected, and empowered to do their best work. We encourage qualified candidates from all backgrounds, experiences, and career paths to apply.



We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

jobs.title: RHTP Primary Care Implementation Specialist
jobs.description:
**Let’s do great things, together!**


**About Moda**  

Founded in Oregon in 1955, Moda is proud to be a company of real people committed to quality. Today, like then, we’re focused on building a better future for healthcare. That starts by offering outstanding coverage to our members, compassionate support to our community and comprehensive benefits to our employees. It keeps going by connecting with neighbors to create healthy spaces and places, together. Moda values diversity and inclusion in our workplace. We aim to demonstrate our commitment to diversity through all our business practices and invite applications from candidates that share our commitment to this diversity. Our diverse experiences and perspectives help us become a stronger organization. Let’s be better together.

  

**Position Summary**



The RHTP Primary Care Implementation Specialist serves as a key liaison between Moda Health and partners at rural hospital\-based primary care clinics on Alaska’s Kenai Peninsula. This role provides technical assistance, subject matter expertise, and project management oversight to advance value\-based payment (VBP) readiness through the National Committee on Quality Assurance (NCQA) Primary Care Medical Home (PCMH) implementation. The position partners with hospital and clinic stakeholders to implement a robust quality improvement and data reporting infrastructure to enable quality measure reporting, support population health management, and prepare clinics for sustainable VBP participation through the NCQA PCMH model.



This is a full\-time position. The ideal candidate will reside in Alaska’s Anchorage/Kenai Peninsula region. *This is a limited duration position contingent on continued receipt of RHTP grant funds.*

  


**Pay Range**



$65,682\.16 \- $82,107\.97annually (depending on experience)  

Actual pay is based on qualifications. Applicants who do not exceed the minimum qualifications will only be eligible for the low end of the pay range.

  

**Please fill out an application on our company page, linked below, to be considered for this position.**



https://j.brt.mv/jb.do?reqGK\=27785428\&refresh\=true  

  

**Benefits****:**


* Medical, Dental, Vision, Pharmacy, Life, \& Disability
* 401K\- Matching
* FSA
* Employee Assistance Program
* PTO and Company Paid Holidays

  

  

**Required Skills, Experience \& Education:**



* Bachelor’s degree or Master’s degree in Public Health, Public Policy, or Healthcare Administration\-related field preferred, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant work experience.


* 3 \- 5 years of experience working in healthcare, public health, or health\-related community\-based organizations. Experience working in or with rural or underserved communities preferred.


* Familiarity with NCQA PCMH and/or Oregon’s Patient\-Centered Primary Care Home requirements and recognition processes.


* Demonstrated understanding of value\-based payment (VBP) systems and APMs in healthcare settings.


* Knowledge of primary care clinic functions such as case management/care coordination, use of electronic health record (EHR) systems, population health\-level metrics and reporting, behavioral health integration, and collaboration with Traditional Health Workers (THWs).


* Proficiency in Microsoft Office, especially MS Excel and other reporting software.


* Strong verbal, written and interpersonal communication skills.
* Experience convening diverse stakeholders and facilitating productive virtual and in\-person meetings.


* Ability to manage complex projects, track activities, and meet short and long\-term project milestones.


* Ability to maintain confidentiality and project a professional business image.
  


**Primary Functions****:**



* Serve as subject matter expert to partner hospital organization leadership on all matters related to PCMH recognition and Alternative Payment Model (APM) design and implementation.


* Regularly meet with steering committee composed of executive leadership from both Alaska hospitals, Moda Health subject matter experts, and statewide policy partners to guide PCMH implementation, resolve barriers, and ensure shared ownership of key decisions.


* Use project management skills to create and maintain detailed implementation plan and task trackers across multiple stakeholder organizations.


* Provide technical assistance to partner organizations, enabling achievement of core and elective criteria for PCMH recognition across the concepts of team\-based care and practice organization, knowing and managing patients, patient\-centered access, care management and support, care coordination and transitions, performance measurement and quality improvement, and behavioral health integration.


* Partner closely with Medicaid Quality and Innovation Manager, Grants Management Specialist, and Medicaid Quality Supervisor to support clinical partners in meeting RHTP requirements and timeline.


* Use independent judgment to make key business decisions and provide informed recommendations on PCMH criteria implementation and APM design to partner organizations and Moda Health senior leadership.


* Perform other duties as assigned.
  



Working Conditions \& Contact with Others:


* Office environment with extensive close PC and keyboard use, constant sitting, and frequent phone communication. Must be able to navigate multiple computer screens. A reliable, high\-speed, hard\-wired internet connection required to support remote or hybrid work. Must be comfortable being on camera for virtual training and meetings. Work in excess of standard workweek, including evenings and occasional weekends, to meet business need. Occasional and overnight travel may be required.
* Internally with all Moda departments. Externally with partner healthcare organizations and vendors.

  


**Together, we can be more. We can be better.**

  

Moda Health seeks to allow equal employment opportunities for all qualified persons without regard to race, religion, color, age, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, marital status, disability, veteran status or any other status protected by law. This is applicable to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absences, compensation, and training.  

  

For more information regarding accommodations please direct your questions to Kristy Nehler and Danielle Baker via our humanresources@modahealth.com email.

jobs.title: Director, Client Onboarding & Implementation
jobs.description:
We're seeking a Director, Client Onboarding \& Implementation to lead the team that will work with internal and external stakeholders to onboard and launch Included Health clients. You will lead a team of managers that support implementation \& operations team members to bring our client contracts to reality. You will collaborate with leaders in sales, client success, operations, product, marketing, legal and finance to evolve processes and infrastructure, including optimization of implementation workflows, playbooks and other related systems. Your data\-driven insights and leadership on strategic \& operational initiatives will help influence the growth trajectory of Included Health and allow us to resolve the most important strategic and operational issues facing the business.The right individual must be able to manage multiple competing priorities and adapt to change in a fast\-paced and continually evolving environment.  



We’re seeking a Director, Implementation to lead the people, operating model, and portfolio delivery disciplines that bring Included Health client commitments to life. This leader will manage and develop Implementation Consultants and Implementation Project Managers, oversee complex client launches, and create the governance, and cross\-functional operating practices needed to deliver consistent, high\-quality outcomes. The role partners closely with Sales, Client Success, Product, Engineering/Systems, Operations, Clinical, and other leaders to improve launch readiness, resolve critical issues, and scale implementation capabilities as the business evolves.  



The ideal candidate combines strong team leadership with deep implementation judgment. They can move between executive\-level client and internal conversations, portfolio\-level risks and tradeoffs, and the operating mechanisms that help implementation teams execute effectively. They should be comfortable using implementation and client\-performance metrics to identify patterns and prioritize action, without needing to be an advanced data analyst.  


### **People Leadership \& Organizational Capacity**


* Lead, develop, and retain a high\-performing organization of implementation leaders, consultants, project managers, and related client\-facing professionals.
* Set clear expectations for delivery quality, client experience, collaboration, and accountability; provide coaching, performance management, and career development.
* Build leadership capacity through succession planning, mentoring, and development of future people leaders.
* Partner with leadership on staffing, capacity planning, workload distribution, and seasonal readiness across the implementation portfolio.

### **Portfolio Delivery \& Launch Outcomes**


* Oversee end\-to\-end implementation delivery across the your team’s portfolio, ensuring appropriate strategy, resourcing, governance, and execution for standard, complex, and transformational launches.
* Establish clear expectations for launch readiness, quality, on\-time delivery, post\-launch stability, and client transition.
* Ensure teams identify dependencies, manage scope and timelines, and maintain clear ownership of critical deliverables and decisions.
* Review portfolio health and intervene early when risks, capacity constraints, or execution issues threaten client or business outcomes.

### **Client Governance \& Executive Escalations**


* Establish effective governance models, operating rhythms, escalation paths, and decision\-making practices for complex implementations.
* Serve as the escalation point for implementation risks and client issues with strategic, commercial, operational, or reputational implications.
* Build trust through transparent communication, sound judgment, clear recommendations, and consistent follow\-through.

### **Implementation Methodology, Quality \& Continuous Improvement**


* Use retrospectives, implementation learnings, client feedback, and performance trends to identify systemic gaps and prioritize improvements.
* Establish quality controls and adoption mechanisms that improve consistency, reduce avoidable escalations, and increase team efficiency.
* Ensure improvements are translated into practical guidance, enablement, and repeatable ways of working for implementation teams.

### **Cross\-Functional Operating Model**


* Align Sales, Client Success, Product, Engineering/Systems, Operations, Clinical, and other partners around implementation priorities, dependencies, decisions, and client outcomes.
* Surface recurring themes and implementation constraints to inform product, process, staffing, and business decisions.
* Clarify ownership and drive resolution when work crosses organizational boundaries or existing processes are insufficient.

### **Product, Technical \& Operational Readiness**


* Maintain sufficient product, systems, integration, and operational fluency to guide implementation strategy and challenge assumptions effectively.
* Partner with Product, Engineering/Systems, Care, Clinical, and Support leaders to ensure technology feeds, integrations, claims readiness, operational processes, and member\-support pathways are prepared for launch.
* Ensure client requirements are translated into feasible implementation approaches while balancing client needs, operational sustainability, and scalable delivery.
* Support the development of tools and reporting that improve visibility into readiness, risks, dependencies, and portfolio performance without taking on day\-to\-day project administration.

### **Client Transition \& Post\-Launch Partnership**


* Partner with Client Success and operational leaders to ensure a clear transition from implementation to ongoing client ownership.
* Monitor early post\-launch performance and ensure material issues have clear owners, communication plans, and durable resolutions.
* Use implementation outcomes and client feedback to strengthen retention, advocacy, and future growth opportunities.

### **Required Qualifications**


* 8\+ years of progressive experience in SaaS implementation, client onboarding, implementation consulting, program management, or project management; 10\+ years preferred.
* 3\+ years of experience leading and developing client\-facing implementation or project management professionals, including managers where applicable.
* Proven experience leading complex, multi\-workstream implementations involving significant cross\-functional dependencies, technical integrations, operational readiness, and executive stakeholders.
* Demonstrated ability to lead both strategic implementation consulting and disciplined project/program execution, either directly or through a blended team of consultants and project managers.
* Proven experience managing risks and escalations, improving quality, and delivering predictable, high\-quality launches.
* Demonstrated executive presence and client leadership skills, including the ability to facilitate senior\-level governance forums, navigate difficult conversations, and build alignment across competing priorities.
* Track record of building scalable implementation methodologies, playbooks, standards, and operating processes that improve consistency, quality, client experience, and team efficiency.
* Strong cross\-functional leadership skills and experience influencing Sales, Client Success, Product, Engineering/Systems, Operations, Clinical, and other partners toward shared client and business outcomes.
* Experience in healthcare, employee benefits, health technology, or a closely related ecosystem, with the ability to understand client, carrier, partner, and operational requirements.
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of education and experience.

### **Preferred Qualifications**


* Experience with healthcare benefits administration, claims operations, carrier ecosystems, or related healthcare data/integration environments.
* Experience leading organizational change management or operating\-model changes.
* PMP, CSM, or another relevant project/program management certification.
* Experience using Salesforce, Cloud Coach, Jira, or similar systems to manage implementation portfolios, capacity, risks, and delivery performance.
* Working fluency with operational and client\-performance metrics, dashboards, and trend analysis to identify risks, prioritize improvements, and support decisions; advanced data analytics experience is not required.
* Experience mentoring leaders, building succession pipelines, and creating a culture of accountability and continuous improvement.
*The base salary range for this full\-time position is $163,830 – $250,668 per year in the United States. This posted range reflects the portion of our internal salary band that is currently funded for new hires in this role across our standard labor markets (Zones A–C).*

jobs.description:
**POSITION TITLE:** Training Coordinator and LMS Administrative Support Specialist


**LOCATION:** Remote


**CLEARANCE:** Must be able to obtain a High\-Risk Public Trust

  


**COMPANY OVERVIEW**

  



At APV, we’re more than a technology company — we’re a mission\-driven powerhouse transforming organizations through advanced technology and human ingenuity. Our expertise spans AI/ML, data architecture, low\-code/no\-code development, Agile DevSecOps, and cloud services, delivering scalable and meaningful solutions.



In our Emerging Technology Lab, innovation drives progress. Our teams create intelligent chatbots, AI\-powered assistants, robotic process automation (RPA), essay graders, and data analytics platforms. If you’re passionate about solving complex challenges and shaping the future, APV is the place for you. Since 2007, we’ve partnered with federal and state agencies to deliver IT, training, and consulting solutions that achieve mission\-critical outcomes. Built on accountability, integrity, and quality, we go beyond expectations. With 70\+ prime contracts and a proven record of client success, APV continues to grow — and we’re looking for exceptional talent to grow with us.

  


**At APV, we Always Provide Value**

  


**POSITION SUMMARY**

  



The Training Coordinator and LMS Administrative Support Specialist will coordinate client training events and provide day\-to\-day operational support for Government\-approved learning activities in client's enterprise learning environment. The role combines training scheduling, participant communications, registration, logistics, materials coordination, and delivery readiness with routine LMS course setup, enrollment, roster, transcript, completion, certification, metadata, and learner\-record administration. Working with client stakeholders, instructors, facilitators, learning systems personnel, and program leadership, this specialist will keep training activities organized, LMS data accurate, and records complete and auditable. The role supports Government\-defined processes and does not independently set priorities, approve governance decisions, redesign enterprise workflows, or perform major system configuration.

  

**DUTIES**

  


* Coordinate Government\-approved virtual and in\-person training events, including schedules, calendars, participant communications, registration, facilities, platforms, materials, and delivery logistics.
* Maintain training calendars and event records and confirm instructor, facilitator, participant, platform, facility, and material readiness before delivery.
* Support the Government's training intake process by documenting incoming requests, capturing requirements, maintaining approved tracking tools, monitoring status, and coordinating follow\-up with stakeholders.
* Prepare, format, quality\-check, and distribute approved course information, participant instructions, rosters, materials, evaluations, and completion documentation through authorized systems and channels.
* Set up and administer courses in the designated enterprise LMS, including course structures, descriptions, metadata, reporting fields, learning paths, enrollment rules, access controls, tracking parameters, and completion criteria.
* Process learner registrations and enrollments; maintain rosters; reconcile attendance; and update completion, transcript, certification, credential, and other learner records.
* Provide routine user account support and basic troubleshooting for enrollment, access, navigation, completion, transcript, and course\-availability issues; document and escalate issues that require technical or Government action.
* Validate course configurations and learner access before deployment and coordinate with learning systems personnel to resolve LMS, data, or content issues.
* Maintain accurate course metadata, catalog entries, learning pathway information, and related records in accordance with Government standards and enterprise catalog governance.
* Reconcile LMS data with attendance records, external files, or other authorized sources; identify discrepancies, document corrective actions, and support accurate reporting and learner history.
* Generate and maintain routine operational reports on registration, attendance, enrollment, completions, transcripts, certifications, course activity, utilization, and service\-request status.
* Maintain complete, current, and auditable records of training requests, course setup, participant communications, attendance, evaluations, completions, LMS actions, issues, approvals, and deliverables.
* Coordinate review of training materials and LMS content for accuracy, completeness, formatting consistency, LMS compatibility, and Section 508 accessibility; document and route deficiencies for remediation before release.
* Support governance and operational meetings by preparing agendas and status information, documenting decisions and action items, and maintaining request, dependency, risk, and outcome records.
* Use approved naming conventions, folder structures, access controls, version\-control practices, and records\-management procedures for training and LMS documentation.
* Protect client information and Government\-furnished equipment, credentials, materials, and records by following security, privacy, and acceptable\-use requirements.
* Monitor competing deadlines, follow up with responsible personnel, communicate status and constraints, and promptly elevate issues that could affect training delivery, learner access, data accuracy, or schedule performance.
* Perform other duties within the scope of the position and contract requirements.

  


**EDUCATION**

  



Bachelor's degree in business administration, education, training and development, human resources, information systems, communications, or a closely related field is required. Years of experience may be used as a substitute for education on a case\-by\-case basis.

  


**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS**

  


* At least three years of relevant professional experience in training coordination, learning operations, LMS administration, event support, program administration, or a comparable role.
* Demonstrated experience scheduling and coordinating virtual or in\-person training, including registration, participant communications, logistics, materials, rosters, attendance, and completion records.
* Experience performing routine LMS administration such as course setup, catalog or metadata maintenance, enrollment processing, user access support, roster management, transcript processing, completion tracking, certification support, or operational reporting.
* Ability to validate course configurations and learner access, perform basic troubleshooting, document issues clearly, and escalate technical or data problems to the appropriate owner.
* Experience maintaining accurate data, reconciling records, correcting discrepancies, and producing auditable reports or operational documentation.
* Intermediate to advanced proficiency with Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, Teams, and shared collaboration or records platforms.
* Strong attention to detail and demonstrated ability to manage multiple training events, service requests, deadlines, records, and stakeholder communications in a primarily remote environment.
* Strong written and verbal communication, customer service, organization, follow\-through, and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to follow Government\-defined intake, governance, records, security, privacy, LMS, accessibility, and approval procedures without exceeding delegated authority.
* Ability to obtain and maintain the credentials, badges, network access, and security approvals required for a Tier 2 Sensitive Moderate Risk position, including required security, privacy, records\-management, and role\-based training.
* Authorization to work in the United States without current or future employer sponsorship.

  


**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

  


* Experience supporting federal agencies, particularly an enterprise learning, public health, scientific, regulatory, or compliance program.
* Experience working in an enterprise LMS and with course catalogs, learning paths, certifications, continuing education, transcripts, or compliance training records.
* Experience coordinating instructor\-led, virtual instructor\-led, blended, or self\-paced learning activities for geographically dispersed audiences.
* Familiarity with Section 508 accessibility requirements, SCORM or comparable eLearning packages, LMS content testing, or accessible Microsoft Office and PDF practices.
* Experience with SharePoint, OneDrive, ServiceNow, Power BI, learning intake tools, help\-desk ticketing, or comparable Government\-approved systems.
* Training or certification in learning management systems, training coordination, records management, Microsoft Office, project coordination, or a related discipline.

  


**ABOUT APV**

  



APV is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants are considered without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, or marital status.

**About Us**

The N.C. Department of Information Technology (NCDIT) serves as the Technology Center for the State of NC. Services that NCDIT provides reach a client base of state and local government agencies, as well as schools, colleges and universities. NCDIT’s mission is to enable trusted business\-driven solutions that meet the needs of North Carolinians. NCDIT provides technology services to state agencies and is charged with closing the digital divide by expanding availability of broadband services and promoting the adoption of affordable, high\-speed internet.


**Description of Work**

Salary Range: $87,617 \- $131,426
  

  

The position is designated Statutory Exempt (EHRA) and is exempt from the State Human Resources Act.
  

  

This position may be eligible for hybrid remote work in accordance with state policy and the agency’s remote work program but does require weekly onsite work. Any telework will be under the conditions of the state Teleworking Program Policy and the employer may end any teleworking arrangement at any time in the employer's sole discretion.
  

  

This is a REPOST. Previous applicants Must Reapply to be considered.
  

  

Are you ready to take the next step in your career?
  

  

We currently have an opening for an Applications Systems Specialist I.
  

  

This position will be part of the Microsoft 365 Service Operations group of the North Carolina Department of Information Technology (NCDIT) Service Delivery division. Primary duties of this position will be to serve as a lead Subject Matter Expert (SME) and product specialist for the Microsoft 365 (M365\) service within NCDIT and other Executive agencies. The position is responsible for designing, implementing, and providing advanced support for the services deployed on M365 platforms by NCDIT. This includes understanding the M365 roadmap and finding solutions to align with the new features or technologies implemented by Microsoft within the North Carolina State policies and security guidelines. Additionally, this position will provide consulting to other State M365 Tenants in the area of security and configuration baselines.
  

  

Key Responsibilities:
  

  

* Serve as the highest level of support in a technical support model responsible for handling the most difficult or advanced problems

  

* Perform high level troubleshooting of very technical and complex M365 issues.

  

* Act as a consultant to management in the review of policies, operations, controls, system development, and data communications and promote standardization across all implementations to lower the Total Cost of Ownership of the Microsoft 365 Suite to the state.

  

* Participate on Project Teams focusing on the Microsoft365 infrastructure systems to ensure information technology information issues are addressed.

  

* Implement new releases of service components into the operational environment following well\-defined controlled processes of change, configuration and release management.

  

* Develop implementation and deployment plans and coordinate with agencies before and during the execution of the project activity.

  

* Ensure application availability, correct configurations and provide team oversight of Microsoft 365 Suite.

  

About the Division:
  

The NCDIT M365 team’s mission is to provide enterprise\-wide communication and collaboration services that improve the productivity and efficiency for the workforce in State government and other authorized government and public\-sector entities. The team offers the Microsoft 365 Suite of Services which includes email, email archiving, Simple Mail Transfer Protocol relays and related services to North Carolina state and local governments, with our core clientele being state Executive Branch agencies. More than 65,000 public servants rely on enterprise\-wide communication services, and we’re preparing for more to come. NCDIT Enterprise Collaboration Services makes ongoing improvements to keep up with our customers’ business and operational needs.
**Knowledge Skills and Abilities/Management Preferences**

**The following Management Preferences are not required, but applicants that possess these skills are preferred:**

  

* Experience in designing, implementing, and supporting M365 services aligned with configuration standards, and roadmap alignment with Microsoft technologies
  

* Demonstrated experience independently handling complex M365 issues, performing deep technical diagnostics, and executing controlled change, configuration, and release management processes
  

* Experience coordinating and overseeing Microsoft 365 deployments across agencies while ensuring accurate configuration, billing fidelity, and strong security through comprehensive assessments, secure baselines, policy compliance, and tenant security guidance
Discover why NCDIT is the ideal destination for your professional growth \- Why Work for NCDIT  



  

**Minimum Education and Experience**

Some state job postings say you can qualify by an “equivalent combination of education and experience.” If that language appears below, then you may qualify through EITHER years of education OR years of directly related experience, OR a combination of both. See the Education and Experience Equivalency Guide for details.  



  

Bachelor's degree in computer science or an IT related field or related technical degree from an appropriately accredited institution and four years of progressive experience in business application consulting or development


**OR**

Associate degree in computer science or an IT related field or related technical degree from an appropriately accredited institution and five years of progressive experience in business application consulting or development


**OR**

High School or General Education Development (GED) diploma and eight years of experience in business application consulting or development; or an equivalent combination of education and experience
